main_text.p: illum baptizatum ; scilicet opponebat Imperatoris illius baptisterium, quod in Basilica Lateranensi visitur. Ob ista & alia ejusdem naturæ, quæ prætereo, Franciscus Barberinus tunc Cardinalis Ne-pos, uti loquuntur, seu Patronus, bibliothecæ custodi revisionem Historiæ illius commisit. Is erat Josephus Maria Suaresius, qui postea factus est Episcopus Vasionensis in Comitatu Avenionensi : Et ut erat vir modestissimus, pacisqve amantissimus, ita ab aulicorum Romanorum ingenio, qui de Morini opere apud summum Pontificem detraxerant, valde alienus fuit. Suaresii amicitiam sibi conciliaverat Morinus beneficio Presbyterorum Congregationis suæ, qui Romæ degebant, variasqve ad eum dedit literas, quæ illi pergratæ fuerunt. Scripsit qvoqve operis sui apologeticam Epistolam ad Cardinalem Franciscum Barperinum, cujus animum a se alienatum senserat. In hac pluribus comprobat, se fuisse semper sedis Apostolicæ studiosissimum, meminitqve officio-ficio

page.notes: Printed "Barperinum" is probably a misprint for "Barberinum" (the name appears as "Barberinus" earlier on the page); left as printed. The word "ficio" on the last line is the second half of "officio", set right-aligned after the hyphen; it is part of the text, not a catchword. The second "ficio" in the text above is a transcription artefact of that line break; the printed text reads "meminitqve of-" then "ficio". Printed "Ne-pos" and "Suaresius" with a long s look like "f" in the scan; read as s. "Morini" appears as "Morini" on the line with "ope-re".
